title: 第12章 格杀勿论
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“对！”

老光把嗓门提到最大，生怕帐篷外的人听不见，“老子就是要跟你比，谁输了谁是这个。”

边说，边用手指比划了一个往外爬的手势。

林珝等他说完，才点头，“好，那就比比。”

帐篷里安静了一瞬。

“如果我输了，我卸任，离开黑风寨。”

林珝看着老光的眼睛，一字一顿，“如果你输了，从今往后，无条件服从我的调令。另外，顶撞头目，照规矩加二十军棍。”

老光把心一横：“比就比，不过——”

他话锋一转，继续挑衅说，“口说无凭，签字画押。省得你打输了，跑到三小姐怀里哭着要奶喝，你说我还打不打？”

人群再次爆发出一阵哄笑。

林珝则面不改色，拿起纸笔，当场写好了字据，又把看了一眼老光。

“呵呵，这可是你自找的，这么多兄弟作证，不怕你抵赖！”

老光歪歪扭扭地签了手印，约定明日午时，在营帐外比试。

立完字据，老光大摇大摆领着一票人走了。

林珝看着他的背影，拔眉毛扬了起来。

新官上任，他正愁找不到地方烧火。

这可是你自己自动送上门的。

很快帐篷里的人就走光了，只有王小虎留下来，一脸担忧道，

“林头儿，你太冲动，老光可是这一带有名的老油子，当了二十年响马，下手黑得很……”

林珝只是笑了笑，在他肩头上拍了一下，“没关系。今晚你负责哨岗，后面的事，你就别参与了。”

他刚来，除了立威，还得尽快拉拢一个自己人。

王小虎年纪小，性格憨直，跟那群老油子不是一伙的，倒是个不错的培养对象。

“可你这……”王小虎张了张嘴，想说什么，最终还是唉声叹气走了。

天后之后，林珝回了自己的小屋。

锁上门，仔细检查了一遍自己留在地上的草木灰，确认没人来过，这才躺下来，闭上眼养精蓄锐。

伤已经好得差不多了，憋屈了这么久，也是时候露一下爪牙。

说到比武，他不怕。

前世当兵练过几年搏击，虽然荒废了些年头，底子还在。

真正让他放心不下的，是马奎。

老光今天在营帐里这么嚣张，马奎不可能不知道，甚至这一切很有可能就是处于对方授意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Yes!"

Lao Guang raised his voice as loud as possible, fearing that the people outside the tent wouldn't be able to hear him, "I just want to compete with you. Whoever loses will get this."

As he spoke, he made a crawling out gesture with his fingers.

Lin Jue waited for him to finish before nodding, "Okay, then let's compete."

The tent was quiet for a moment.

"If I lose, I will resign and leave Black Wind Village."

Lin Jue looked into Lao Guang's eyes and said word by word, "If you lose, you will obey my orders unconditionally from now on. In addition, if you contradict the leader, you will be given twenty military sticks according to the rules."

Lao Guang was worried: "It's a competition, but -"

He changed the topic and continued to challenge, "What you say is unfounded, and you sign and pledge it. If you lose the fight and run into the arms of the third lady crying for milk, do you think I should fight you?"

The crowd burst into laughter again.

Lin Jue's expression did not change, he picked up a pen and paper, wrote the note on the spot, and looked at Lao Guang again.

"Haha, you asked for this. With so many brothers testifying, I'm not afraid of you denying it!"

Lao Guang signed his fingerprint crookedly and agreed to compete outside the camp at noon tomorrow.

After setting up the documents, Lao Guang swaggered and led a group of people away.

Lin Jue looked at his back and raised her eyebrows.

When the new official took office, he was worried about finding a place to light the fire.

This is delivered to your door automatically.

Soon everyone in the tent was gone, and only Wang Xiaohu stayed, saying with a worried look on his face,

"Boss Lin, you are too impulsive. Lao Guang is a famous old man in this area. He has been a thief for twenty years and his tricks are very dark..."

Lin Jue just smiled and patted him on the shoulder, "It doesn't matter. You are in charge of the sentry post tonight, but don't get involved in what happens next."

When he first arrived, in addition to establishing his authority, he also had to win over one of his own as soon as possible.

Wang Xiaohu is young and has a straightforward personality. He is not in the same group as those old guys, but he is a good training target.

"But you..." Wang Xiaohu opened his mouth, wanting to say something, but finally sighed and left.

After the queen's visit, Lin Jue returned to her hut.

He locked the door and carefully checked the ashes he left on the ground to make sure no one had been there before lying down, closing his eyes and recuperating.

The injury has almost healed. After holding it in for so long, it's time to show off my claws.

When it comes to combat, he's not afraid.

In my previous life, I was a soldier and practiced fighting for several years. Although it has been neglected for some years, the foundation is still there.

What really worried him was Ma Kui.

It is impossible for Ma Kui not to know that Lao Guang was so arrogant in the camp today, and it is even possible that all this was done under his instruction.
